mainEntity.name: Which XF Sportbrake engines do you work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work on the 2.2 diesel, 3.0 V6 diesel and 2.0 Ingenium engines used across both Sportbrake generations, following an initial assessment.

mainEntity.name: What is the XF Sportbrake engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour required. We provide a quote after assessing your Sportbrake rather than a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Do you have an XF Sportbrake engine for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can source and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your Sportbrake's engine code. Contact us with your registration to check availability.

mainEntity.name: Does towing affect my Sportbrake's engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular towing or heavy loads can add strain over time. Following the correct service schedule and addressing warning signs early can help protect the engine.

mainEntity.name: Does a rattle mean my timing chain needs replacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. A rattle can have several causes. An inspection is needed to confirm whether the timing chain or another part is responsible.

mainEntity.name: How long will an XF Sportbrake engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining needed. We will give you an estimated timeframe once the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my Sportbrake from outside Essex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer collection and delivery across the UK, so you can access our workshop wherever your Sportbrake is based.
